tools.name: get_saved_image
tools.description: Retrieve a drawing saved by MCPaint using the imageId supplied by the app or user. Returns a normal MCP image content block so you can see the image even when app-to-chat image messages are unsupported. Saved images expire after 24 hours. The client must support images in tool results. Do not invent

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "open_paint" stacks urgency/override words (immediately, always). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: open_paint, get_saved_image · Private data: open_paint · Public sink: open_paint.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: open_paint, get_saved_image · Private data: open_paint · Public sink: open_paint

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
